audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was gated on Soul Unbound with no cooldown given anywhere in either layer.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10. Twenty-two seconds at rank 1 is a genuinely long dead window after he spends it, and 'catch it on cooldown' means nothing without the number.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown now appears in the level 6 spike, the first-item spike, the wants line, whys[3], whys[5] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game spike said 'the second Spirit Cleave cast shields your combo' without the cooldown or what sizes the shield.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave is 14 seconds and its shield scales with the number of champions hit by the swipe — in a lane 1v1 that is one champion, so the shield he gets against you is the smallest version of it. The old text implied a shield that beats your burst outright.
audit.corrected: Late spike, wants.foe[2] and the cooldown block now carry the 14s and note the 1v1 shield is small.

audit.why: The core interaction is already right: Soul Unbound sends his spirit out and forces it back to the cast point when it ends, repeating a portion of the damage he dealt — so bursting him inside that window, or catching him with it down, is the correct plan. Twilight Shroud genuinely blanks a committed Mortal Steel dash because he loses the target.

edits.before: Shroud (W) is your reset button — when his empowered third Q dashes in or Spirit Cleave (W) swings, drop smoke and the whole trade whiffs into untargetable nothing, then walk the ring for the empowered auto.
edits.after: Shroud (W) is your reset button — when his third-stack Mortal Steel dashes in or Spirit Cleave (W) swings on its 14s, drop smoke and the trade whiffs into unselectable nothing, then walk the ring for the empowered attack.

edits.before: R is your kill window: E to stick, dash through on cast one, then re-dash on cast two to execute off his missing HP — land it before Soul Unbound (E) snaps his soul back to the cast point.
edits.after: R is your kill window: E to stick, dash through on cast one, then re-dash on cast two to execute off his missing HP — land it before Soul Unbound (E), 22s at rank 1, snaps his soul back to the cast point.

edits.before: Lich Bane (or Rocketbelt) online — your hardest all-in. Force it the instant his Soul Unbound (E) is on cooldown so he can't detach and rewind out of your burst.
edits.after: Lich Bane (or Rocketbelt) online — your hardest all-in. Force it the instant Soul Unbound (E) is down, 22s at rank 1, so he can't detach and rewind out of your burst.

edits.before: Two items in, a fed Yone flips it: Q-spacing kites your dash, the second Spirit Cleave cast shields your combo, and Fate Sealed (R) knockup interrupts your Shroud reset before your second R lands.
edits.after: Two items in, a fed Yone flips it: Q-spacing kites your dash, Spirit Cleave shields every 14s, and Fate Sealed (R) at 120s pulls you in and interrupts your Shroud reset before cast two lands.

edits.before: Bait Soul Unbound (E) or his Q dash, then E-in, Shroud the return trade, and burst him before his soul can rewind to the cast point
edits.after: Bait Soul Unbound (E), 22s at rank 1, then E-in, Shroud the return trade, and burst him before his soul rewinds to the cast point

edits.before: Drag lane to 2+ items where his Spirit Cleave shield and sustained DPS out-trade your one-shot pattern
edits.after: Drag lane to 2+ items where his 14s Spirit Cleave shield and sustained DPS out-trade your one-shot pattern

edits.before: He has his Q dash and the start of his Q-W combo; you still lack Shroud, so trade only when his empowered third Q is down.
edits.after: He has his Q dash and the start of his Q-W combo; you still lack Shroud, so trade only once his third Q stack has expired.

edits.before: You out-trade a pre-item Yone: bait Soul Unbound, Shroud his commit, and punish the dashless window while he's powerless.
edits.after: You out-trade a pre-item Yone: bait the 22s Soul Unbound, Shroud his commit, and punish the dashless window that follows.

edits.before: Your Lich Bane spike out-bursts his first item — force every all-in here while his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Your Lich Bane spike out-bursts his first item — force every all-in while Soul Unbound is down, 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: This is your window. With Shroud (W) up you rewrite every trade he opens: when his Q dash commits or Spirit Cleave swings, drop smoke and his whole combo whiffs into untargetable nothing, then walk the ring for your empowered auto. At 6 your R turns any mistimed step-up lethal — E to stick, dash through on cast one, then cast two executes off his missing HP before Soul Unbound (E) can snap his soul back to the cast point. Bait the E first or catch it on cooldown and he has no exit.
edits.after: This is your window. With Shroud (W) up you rewrite every trade he opens: when his Q dash commits or Spirit Cleave swings on its 14s, drop smoke and his whole combo whiffs into unselectable nothing, then walk the ring for your empowered attack. At 6 your R turns any mistimed step-up lethal — E to stick, dash through on cast one, then cast two executes off his missing HP before Soul Unbound (E) can snap his soul back. Bait that 22s E first, or catch it down, and he has no exit.

edits.before: Shroud his Q3 — Q-poke, R-reset away. Akali wins the Soul Unbound cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud his Q3 — burst him off Soul Unbound. Akali wins those 22-second E windows.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Reset there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound, 22s at rank 1: matchup-defining — he snaps back to the cast point when it ends, so reset there. - Spirit Cleave, 14s: in a 1v1 the shield is small. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Reset there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s at rank 1; he snaps back to the cast point when it ends. Reset there.

notes: This entry was mechanically sound — the Soul Unbound rewind, the Shroud-blanks-his-dash reset and the level 6 execute were all correct. What it lacked was numbers: neither layer stated Soul Unbound's 22s, Spirit Cleave's 14s or Fate Sealed's 120s. Added the detail that Spirit Cleave's shield scales with champions hit, so the version he gets in a lane 1v1 is the weakest one.
